content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Beaumont

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: The PMP requires either a bachelor's degree plus three years of project-management experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Review PMI's full eligibility criteria to confirm your education and documented work history meet the requirement before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Bootcamp. Attend all required sessions from your location, interact with active certified practitioners, and build the foundational knowledge and exam strategies you'll need to pass.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the bootcamp, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience details. Pay the associated exam fee to PMI, then await approval. Granite PM Academy staff can guide you through the application process.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Test for the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and instructor support to solidify your readiness. Schedule your exam through PMI's testing partner, then sit for the computer-based exam at an authorized testing center.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to earning professional development units (PDUs) across the standard three-year renewal cycle. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses and resources to help you fulfill your renewal requirements and keep your expertise current.
